home.title: Puzzles from your own pictures
home.intro: Upload an image, pick the number of pieces and solve your personal puzzle right in the browser — with real, interlocking jigsaw pieces. Share the link so others can join in.
home.step2: Upload your own image (JPG, PNG or WebP).
home.step3: Choose the number of pieces: 12, 48, 108 or 300.
home.step4: Save the puzzle and share the link — solving works without an account too.

legal.imprintIntro: Provider information under § 5 of the German Digital Services Act (DDG).
legal.privateService: This is a private, non-commercial service. There is no company register entry and no VAT identification number.
legal.notConfiguredText: No complete operator details are configured for this instance. Whoever runs it needs to set these environment variables before the service is publicly reachable: {fields}.
legal.controllerText: The person named in the legal notice is the controller for the processing of your data. For any privacy question, reach them at the contact details given there.
legal.controllerMissing: No operator details are configured for this instance, so no controller is named here. Without them the rights listed below cannot be exercised — whoever runs the instance needs to supply them.
legal.accountText: When you sign up we store your email address, a name if you choose to give one, your password as a bcrypt hash (never in plain text), whether and when you confirmed your email address, your role and when you signed up. This data is needed to run your account; the legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
legal.tokensText: For email confirmation and for invitations we generate a random token with an expiry date, tied to your account. It is deleted when redeemed; a link that is never redeemed stops being valid once it expires, but the entry itself stays until the account is deleted.
legal.bansText: To prevent abuse, individual email addresses and whole domains can be blocked. We store the entry itself and when it was created, for as long as the block is in place. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — the legitimate interest in running the service free of abuse.
legal.puzzlesText: For every puzzle we store the title, the uploaded image, its dimensions, the piece count, the seed for the random cut, who owns it, whether it is public and when it was created.
legal.imagesText: Every image is re-encoded to WebP on upload and scaled down to at most 2000 pixels on its longest edge. All metadata of the original is lost in the process, GPS coordinates included — so only the pixels are stored, not what your camera recorded about the shot.
legal.imagesPublicText: Please note: images of public puzzles are served without sign-in, so that a shared link works without an account. Anyone who knows an image's address can retrieve it, and caches may keep copies. The same goes for a public puzzle's own details: title, dimensions, piece count and creation time can be retrieved without signing in. Do not upload anything that should not be public.
legal.localText: Your solving progress is kept in your browser's local storage so you can resume a puzzle later. This data never leaves your device and can be cleared through your browser settings.
legal.cookiesText: We set only cookies that are technically necessary: NEXT_LOCALE for the language you picked, and the cookies our sign-in library needs — a session cookie (authjs.session-token) and two that secure the sign-in exchange itself (authjs.csrf-token and authjs.callback-url). The latter three appear as soon as you use the sign-in page. All of them are strictly necessary to run the service, so no consent is required (§ 25(2) TDDDG). No analytics, advertising or tracking services are used, and no third-party content is embedded.
legal.logsText: The application itself keeps no access log: it stores neither IP addresses nor the pages requested. Technical details about malfunctions can end up in the server's error output. The infrastructure in front of it may briefly keep access logs including IP addresses in order to detect attacks and faults; the legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
legal.recipientsMailSelf: Confirmation and invitation emails are sent through a mail server we operate ourselves. Your address is not passed to any third party for this.
legal.recipientsMailExternal: Confirmation and invitation emails are sent through {provider}. That service receives your email address and processes it on our behalf as a processor (Art. 28 GDPR).
legal.recipientsStorageSelf: Uploaded images are kept on storage we operate ourselves and are not transferred to any third party.
legal.recipientsStorageExternal: Uploaded images are kept at {provider}, which stores them on our behalf as a processor (Art. 28 GDPR).
legal.recipientsOther: Beyond that we do not share your data, unless we are legally obliged to.
legal.hostingTextUnknown: Where this instance is operated is not stated in this policy. The person named in the legal notice will tell you on request.
legal.retentionText: Account data is stored for as long as your account exists. When it is deleted, we remove it together with your puzzles and their images. Confirmation and invitation links disappear when redeemed; an expired link that was never redeemed is not cleaned up automatically and goes away with the account. Block entries remain for as long as the block applies.
legal.rightsText: You have the right of access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21 GDPR). A message to the address in the legal notice is enough; no particular form is required.
legal.rightsComplaint: You can also complain to a data protection authority — either the one where you live or the one responsible for the controller.
legal.changesText: We update this policy when the service changes. The current version is always on this page; the date above shows when it last changed.
legal.termsScopeText: These terms govern the use of this puzzle service. The operator is the person named in the legal notice. By registering — including via an invitation — you accept these terms.
legal.termsServiceText: The service lets you create puzzles from uploaded images, solve them and share them publicly. It is provided free of charge; there is no entitlement to particular features.
legal.termsAccountText: Registration requires a working email address. Keep your password secret; whatever happens through your account is attributed to you. An account is not transferable.
legal.termsContentIntro: You may only upload images you are legally allowed to use. The following are prohibited in particular:
legal.termsContentPornographic: pornographic content and other content harmful to minors — the service is aimed at a general audience;
legal.termsContentIllegal: unlawful content, such as depictions of violence, incitement to hatred or symbols of unconstitutional organisations;
legal.termsContentRights: content that infringes third-party rights — in particular copyright and the personality rights of people depicted.
legal.termsContentResponsibility: You are responsible for what you upload. Images of public puzzles can be retrieved without signing in — do not upload anything that should not be public.
legal.termsModerationText: We may remove content that violates these terms without prior notice, and in case of violations suspend or delete accounts and exclude email addresses and domains from registration. Reports of violations are received at the address named in the legal notice.
legal.termsAvailabilityText: There is no entitlement to constant availability. The service may change or be discontinued; we will give registered users reasonable notice of a shutdown.
legal.termsLiabilityText: We are fully liable for intent and gross negligence, and for damage resulting from injury to life, body or health. Beyond that, liability is excluded to the extent permitted by law.
legal.termsChangesText: We update these terms when the service or the legal situation changes. The current version is always on this page; the date above shows the last substantive change. For material changes we will ask you to accept the new version at your next sign-in.
